Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle
was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. The mechanism and force of
impact are consistent with the reported distal radius injury. Radiographs and
examination findings support a wrist fracture, with localized tenderness and reduced
grip strength on the affected side, while neurovascular testing and the remaining
range-of-motion checks were within normal limits. Over six visits, care followed a
standard course of immobilization, pain management, and progressive therapy exercises.
Visit frequency decreased as symptoms improved and function returned. The record also
notes prior treatment to the same body region within the past two years, and that
earlier condition contributes to some of the current complaints. Billed services
correspond to the visits documented, with no repeated charges identified. Patient is
expected to continue home exercises and return for reassessment if symptoms change.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
